name: shopify-rich-text-editor
description: Reusable Shopify App rich text editor workspace with React, Tiptap, Polaris, and server-side Shopify HTML rendering.
author: Standhigher

scripts.pack:dry-run: NPM_CONFIG_CACHE=/tmp/best-rich-text-npm-cache pnpm --filter @standhigher/shopify-rich-text-core exec npm pack --dry-run && NPM_CONFIG_CACHE=/tmp/best-rich-text-npm-cache pnpm --filter @standhigher/shopify-rich-text-editor exec npm pack --dry-run && NPM_CONFIG_CACHE=/tmp/best-rich-text-npm-cache pnpm --filter @standhigher/shopify-rich-text-server exec npm pack --dry-run
scripts.release:check: git diff --check && pnpm -r typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build && pnpm pack:dry-run && pnpm pack:check && pnpm consumer:check
scripts.release:major: npm version major --no-git-tag-version && pnpm --filter @standhigher/shopify-rich-text-editor-demo version major --no-git-tag-version && pnpm --filter @standhigher/shopify-rich-text-core version major --no-git-tag-version && pnpm --filter @standhigher/shopify-rich-text-editor version major --no-git-tag-version && pnpm --filter @standhigher/shopify-rich-text-server version major --no-git-tag-version
scripts.release:minor: npm version minor --no-git-tag-version && pnpm --filter @standhigher/shopify-rich-text-editor-demo version minor --no-git-tag-version && pnpm --filter @standhigher/shopify-rich-text-core version minor --no-git-tag-version && pnpm --filter @standhigher/shopify-rich-text-editor version minor --no-git-tag-version && pnpm --filter @standhigher/shopify-rich-text-server version minor --no-git-tag-version
scripts.release:patch: npm version patch --no-git-tag-version && pnpm --filter @standhigher/shopify-rich-text-editor-demo version patch --no-git-tag-version && pnpm --filter @standhigher/shopify-rich-text-core version patch --no-git-tag-version && pnpm --filter @standhigher/shopify-rich-text-editor version patch --no-git-tag-version && pnpm --filter @standhigher/shopify-rich-text-server version patch --no-git-tag-version
scripts.release:publish: pnpm release:check && pnpm --filter @standhigher/shopify-rich-text-core exec npm publish --access public --registry https://registry.npmjs.org/ && pnpm --filter @standhigher/shopify-rich-text-editor exec npm publish --access public --registry https://registry.npmjs.org/ && pnpm --filter @standhigher/shopify-rich-text-server exec npm publish --access public --registry https://registry.npmjs.org/
scripts.test: pnpm -r test && pnpm exec vitest run tests/compatibility
